python3 << 'EOF'
# 1953 Monthly National defense and related activities (in millions)
data_1953 = [3632, 3501, 3789, 3891, 3746, 4056, 3890, 3519, 3787, 3647, 3540, 3465]

# 1940 Monthly National defense (in millions)
data_1940 = [132, 129, 143, 159, 154, 153, 177, 200, 219, 287, 376, 473]

sum_1953 = sum(data_1953)
sum_1940 = sum(data_1940)

print(f"1953 Total: {sum_1953}")
print(f"1940 Total: {sum_1940}")

# Absolute percent difference: |A - B| / ((A + B) / 2) * 100
abs_percent_diff = abs(sum_1953 - sum_1940) / ((sum_1953 + sum_1940) / 2) * 100

print(f"\nAbsolute Percent Difference: {abs_percent_diff:.2f}%")
EOF
